listing.name: Twisted Metal — TwistedMetal1234Recomp (jcoker85)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project provides a native Windows four-game launcher with game-specific hooks and settings. A shared launcher does not establish a complete TM1 campaign or working player. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PS1 USA TwistedMetal retail SCUS94304 CHD or CUE/BIN. Other launcher games have different disc profiles and are not interchangeable.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the shared Windows launcher release, or tools/generate.sh for a source build with your own disc. Select TwistedMetal tm1 with your own SCUS94304. Recompiled C is generated locally, and the discs remain required. This is the existing shared launcher implementation.

warnings: The project provides a native Windows four-game launcher with game-specific hooks and settings. A shared launcher does not establish a complete TM1 campaign or working player.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
